decisions.reason: Selecting the client's main YouTube channel does not change the existing iOS strategy of streaming the video externally rather than bundling it.
The hosting-channel choice does not alter the Bend, Align, and Measure instruction sequence.
The video hosting channel does not change Android localization coverage, language count, or full-app scope.
The video hosting channel does not change iOS localization coverage or full-app localization scope.
The source identifies where the tutorial video will be hosted but supplies no social-media link or change to the requirement that existing links resolve.
Choosing a YouTube hosting channel does not change the requirement to localize every social-media link.
The specific external hosting channel does not change the Android app-size goal or any recorded optimization technique.
The video hosting channel has no effect on Android permission policy or removal of READ_PHONE_STATE.
The hosting-channel choice does not change the iOS framework, deprecated-API, or maintainability requirements.
Hosting the tutorial video on the client's YouTube channel does not alter the requirement for an iOS Privacy Manifest.
The tutorial video's hosting channel has no effect on iOS signing certificates or submission signing configuration.
The video hosting channel does not change right-to-left layout behavior for supported locales.
